ibc_denoms.hash: ibc/ + uppercase SHA-256 of the one-hop trace path
ibc_denoms.note: One-hop ICS-20 denoms for the open morocco-1 transfer channels. Hermes polls morocco-1 at http://127.0.0.1:26657/block_results and relays transfer/channel-0 (Juno), plus channel-9, channel-10, and channel-11. Secret (channel-7, channel-8; clients 07-tendermint-28/-31) is a dropped route: not relayed, recovered or refreshed. The clients on these channels are Expired. Stargaze, Evmos, and OmniFlix are halted, so those denoms are recorded and not relayed. No new AtomOne or Penumbra client has been created. Temporary mint denoms, including Osmosis-routed UM, ETH, ZEC, and BTC, are in temp_mint_denoms and do not replace this table. The daemon copy of this file is ~/.cw-orch/state.json.

temp_mint_denoms.role: Temporary accepted options for shitstrap and svg mints while the older canonical channels are reopened. These rows extend on_terp. They do not replace it.
temp_mint_denoms.hash: ibc/ + uppercase SHA-256 of the full trace
